title: [Epilepsy Warning] Choco Mountain: The History of Mario Kart 64's Most Infamous Track
summary: Summoning Salt traces the speedrunning history of Mario Kart 64's Choco Mountain track and its famous shortcut, through the successive record holders and discoveries. It carries an epilepsy warning for flickering lights.
why: HN recommends it as a gripping entry point into speedrunning and as a model of a well-made history video.

quote.text: I didn't realize I cared about speed-running until I saw this YouTube video from Summoning Salt
